hero.paragraph: Sixtravel is a premium travel company creating sophisticated journeys across Kerala, India, and the world — private escapes, family journeys, executive travel, corporate movements, destination experiences, and founder-led journeys, brought together with discernment.

portfolio.heading: Three ways to travel. One distinctive standard.

ways.title: Corporate Travel
ways.body: When business takes you across borders, precision matters. SIX TRAVEL manages sophisticated corporate journeys for executives, leadership teams, companies, delegations, meetings, events, incentives, and retreats.

kerala.intro: Kerala is not simply where we operate. It is where our understanding of travel begins. SIX TRAVEL reveals Kerala through a more discerning lens — connecting travelers with remarkable stays, intimate experiences, extraordinary landscapes, and the cultural character that exists beyond the postcard.

curation.eyebrow: The Six Experience™ & The Art of Curation

blocks.title: The Six Experience™
blocks.heading: We don't simply arrange the journey. We compose it.
blocks.body: The finest travel experiences are rarely defined by a single hotel or destination. They are created through the relationship between every detail: the arrival, the property, the room, the view, the vehicle, the table, the experience, the moment between destinations.

blocks.title: The Art of Curation
blocks.heading: We don't simply choose. We edit.
blocks.body: The world offers endless possibilities. Our value lies in knowing which ones deserve your time. Find the exceptional. Remove the unnecessary. Create the unforgettable.

selective.heading: Exceptional travel demands attention.
selective.body: SIX TRAVEL is not built around volume. We believe truly considered travel requires time — to understand the traveler, study the destination, refine the details, and create something genuinely distinctive. So we remain selective.
selective.closing: Fewer templates. Greater imagination. Closer attention. More memorable journeys.

standard.heading: The Six Standard™ — a higher expectation of travel.
standard.intro: The Six Standard is more than a service philosophy. It is the discipline behind every journey we deliver.

principles.title: Curation
principles.line: Chosen with taste, relevance, and intention.
principles.body: The world offers endless possibilities. Our value lies in knowing which ones deserve your time.

principles.title: Personalization
principles.line: Built around the traveler, not a predetermined package.
principles.body: Nothing templated. Nothing excessive. Everything considered around who you are and how you move.

principles.title: Precision
principles.line: Every transition, reservation, and detail thoughtfully coordinated.
principles.body: The finest travel experiences are created through the relationship between every detail, not a single hotel or destination.

principles.title: Discovery
principles.line: Beyond landmarks and into the character of a destination.
principles.body: Less itinerary. More immersion. Less tourism. More discovery.

principles.title: Service
principles.line: Discreet, responsive, and attentive from departure to return.
principles.body: True luxury is rarely loud. It is the detail already handled before you have to ask.

principles.title: Experience
principles.line: Because the ultimate measure of a journey is what remains after it ends.
principles.body: We do not simply arrange the journey. We compose it — so what remains is worth remembering.
